cold_open.hook: Apple down 3.1%, Nasdaq off 1%, but a sea drone just rescued a US Army helicopter crew—and it cost less than a Tesla.

markets.macro_note: Tech rolling over, defensives holding—VIX down but breadth is thin.

big_story.story_title: Sea drone rescues US Army helicopter crew near Strait of Hormuz
big_story.angle: Autonomous drones just proved they can execute a real-world military rescue in one of the world's most contested waterways—this isn't a demo, it's a capability shift.

quick_hits.angle: OpenAI filed for IPO—the company that broke the internet is now asking the internet to buy it at a valuation nobody can justify yet.
Lovable hit $500M annualized revenue with 1 million new projects a week—it's an AI code-gen tool that's growing so fast it's outpacing the ability to explain what it does.
Trump's new trade target is forced labor—sounds moral until you realize the enforcement mechanism is a tariff on the countries that actually enforce it.
Palo Alto Networks hit $10B revenue run rate and beats the S&P 500 across all timeframes—cybersecurity is the one sector that doesn't need a macro excuse to go up.

odd_thing.joke_angle: A color-changing light finally made someone appreciate color-changing lights—the bar for 'innovation' is now 'does the thing it was supposed to do from the start.'

sign_off.callback_target: the sea drone rescue—tie back to how a $500K autonomous system just did the job of a $100M helicopter in the Strait of Hormuz
